newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 60 bln bolivar TEM auction Wed.

text.p: The Central Bank of Venezuela announced for Wednesday morning a 30 billion bolivar ($64 million) auction of 177-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills with a 29.01 percent coupon.
The bank said it would also offer 15 billion bolivars in 269-day bills with a 30.06 percent coupon, and another 15 billion bolivars of 358-day bills with a 31.13 percent coupon.
The issue exceeds the 50 billion bolivars of TEMs due to mature on Thursday.
The weekly TEM bill auctions are the Central Bank's principal tool of monetary policy, used to restrict liquidity and establish a benchmark for wider interest rates.
